But in **Cairo**, even in clear conditions, the **sky is too bright** to see such a faint object.

---

### 📌 **Conclusion:**
**No, you would not be able to see the Moon with your unaided eyes right now.**  
It's **too close to the Sun** and **too faint** to be visible in **bright daylight**.

---

### 📝 **Optional Tip:**
If you want to see the Moon, you'd need to wait until **after sunset**, when the sky becomes darker and the Moon becomes more illuminated. The next time the Moon will be **visible to the naked eye** in the evening will be when it's **more than a few days** past the new moon — typically around **first quarter** or later.
